messages.author: 6fd1fccedadfe847
messages.subject: mshape for groups
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to compare mean shape of specimens who belong to different groups (e.g. female, sites). I'd like to use plotRefToTarget for this, but the function mshape in the guide only specify how to compare mean shape of "Y.gpa$coords" (which mean all specimens) to a specific specimen. So (being new to R) my question is how do I get mshape of a group using the classifiers.csv I created. I searched the help for mshape and couldn't find any argument like "groups =", so I guess the solution should lie in creating a sub-group of $coords. I thought of using 'subset' on gdf since I already have coords and factors all together, but they're not in the same matrix. Is there a way to use gdf$shape or Y.gpa$coords with my classifiers.csv (already included in both Y.gpa$coords & gdf$shape) to extract only specific rows (e.g. time== "before")?
When trying this:
A = subset(gdf$shape, time == "before")
I get:
Error in time == "before" :
  comparison (1) is possible only for atomic and list types
Avi

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] Re: mshape for groups
parts:
Hi Avi,

I was just about to recommend coords.subset.  To take this a step further - to get means for each subset - using the example,

new.coords <- coords.subset(A = pupfish$coords, group = group)

do the following:

lapply(new.coords, mshape)

This will give you group means.  

Mike

parts:
Hi Mike,
I'm trying to use the same techique to do MANOVA on sub-groups (e.g. only on type A sites).
I tried these two options:

# 1:
time.type1 = procD.lm(f1=shape ~ time/type, data=gdf, iter=999, RRPP=T, print.progress=F)
time.type.u2 = nested.update(P=time.type1, f1= ~ time/type)
summary(time.site1)

# 2:
gp6 = as.factor(paste(classifiers$Time, classifiers$Type))
time.type2 = coords.subset(salamander3d.gpa$coords, group=gp6)
sub.before.lentic = time.type2$`Before Lentic`
sub.before.lotic = time.type2$`Before Lotic`
sub.after.lentic = time.type2$`After Lentic`
sub.after.lotic = time.type2$`After Lotic`
time.type3 = procD.lm(f1=shape ~ sub.before.lentic + sub.before.lotic + sub.after.lentic + sub.after.lotic, data=gdf, iter=999, RRPP=T, print.progress=F)

Whenever I do MANOVA on sites, I get that there's a diff. between them, most likely because they belong to 2 diff. type of sites. So the idea is to do MANOVA among sites only for one type of site. I'm not sure how do I do that.
Can you help?

Avi
